title: App resource payload
description: Responsibility-level projection of an App at honua://apps/{appId}. Concrete field spellings finalize upstream (honua-server#731); only the stable appId is pinned. Responsibilities: target SDK declaration, template binding, package format/manifest, bundle artifact, delivery asset manifest, map binding, runtime config schema, hosting/route hints, bound data artifacts. See resources.md §honua://apps/{appId}.

controls.description: Standard-owned input affordances; the collection `control:{id}` references resolve against (ADR-0031).

explorationContexts.description: Standard-owned units of shared interaction state; the primary interaction model, which components join by naming a context (ADR-0032).

interactions.description: Standard-owned declarative event→action bindings, narrowed by ADR-0032 to one-shot gestures (ADR-0030).
